purpose: Teach: キックオフ/型式/買い取っ/アダプター/コネクタ/ブランク/送り出す/圏外

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員総会のキックオフを大事にされた
lines.en: Dad always made the founding staff meetings and kickoffs something sacred.
lines.style: Gentle recollection, unhurried pace. Respectful weight on 'always made.' Fond, almost surprised by his own memory. Eyes slightly distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは機械の型式選定に時間をかけられた
lines.en: Yes. He spent real time choosing the right machinery specifications.
lines.style: Steady affirmation, measured and clear. Slight pause before the second sentence—gathering the memory. Tone is grateful, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、古い在庫を自ら買い取って整理された
lines.en: When he was young, he bought out old inventory himself and sorted through it all.
lines.style: Soft admiration in the voice. Slight shake of the head—marveling at the memory. Pace slows on 'himself.' Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外製アダプターも自ら検品された
lines.en: Yes. He personally inspected every overseas adapter that came through.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Deliberate on 'personally'—this detail matters. Not boasting, but bearing witness. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、工場のコネクタ規格を統一する案を出された
lines.en: When he was young, he proposed standardizing the connector specs across the whole factory.
lines.style: Soft voice, almost to himself. 'He proposed'—delivered with quiet respect for the boldness of it. Eyes back to that younger version of him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の休暇のブランクも尊重された
lines.en: Yes. He respected his staff's time off completely—never pressured them on gaps between leaves.
lines.style: Warm affirmation, gentle emphasis on 'completely.' This speaks to character, not just management. Slow delivery. The respect in his voice mirrors the respect he's describing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、自社製品を世界に送り出す夢を語られた
lines.en: When he was young, he talked about sending our own products out into the world.
lines.style: Tender nostalgia. The word 'talked'—he can still hear it. Slight lift on 'world,' like the dream had no boundaries. Breath of longing underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外出張時の圏外時の対策に詳しかった
lines.en: Yes. He knew everything about staying connected when he traveled overseas—never caught off guard.
lines.style: Steady close, almost a benediction. Slow measured delivery. 'Never caught off guard'—small detail that says so much. Voice settles into respect.
